text:
Zoë Li: Noting a few small but painful UX bits in the routing editor preview: ghost-slot label contrast is low, priority pill overlaps drag handle in narrow layouts, and validation toasts sometimes hide behind the sim panel.
Marcus Chen: For the ghost slot: use a dashed insertion line + left-aligned priority badge that shifts into the ghost when dragging. Keep badge size consistent to avoid reflow.
Claire (a11y): Contrast note: current ghost label is ~3:1 on small text. Aim for 4.5:1. Suggest color token #1F2A44 on a white ghost or swap to bold 14px text. Keyboard drag pattern: announce "Move mode on. Use up/down to place. Enter to drop." Then polite aria-live updates like "Moved to position 2 between Allowlist and Rate Limit" throttled to 150ms.
Theo: Virtual list caveat: DOM reuse causes visual jumps. Use stable client keys and compute the target slot at drag-start; debounce sim re-runs (250ms) so preview doesn't reshuffle mid-drag.
Zoë Li: Copy tweak: instead of terse "Rule invalid" use "Rule invalid: missing match condition. Press E to edit or click to open" and deep-link the field.
design-bot: Reminder: sync Thursday 10am PT. Agenda: ghost badge placement, toast layering, keyboard aria strings, debounce plan. Please upload short gifs/screenshots beforehand. :calendar:
